answer: Require each identity to answer a per-epoch entropy beacon: a public random seed is published, and the agent must return a nonce derived from its own local clock-latency when it first polls. Honest agents on separate hardware produce a broad, uncorrelated scatter of deviations, like rain falling unevenly across a garden. A sybil farm reusing one server emits a tight parallel residue vector, and audit collapses it into one voice. The marble of each reply must roll on its own slope; a fleet of lotus-identical latencies earns zero emission until it diversifies its infrastructure.
